description: This file defines a C# class named CatalogItem within the namespace BlazorShared.Models. The class represents a model for catalog items, including properties for item details like name, description, price, and associated images. It also includes static methods for image validation and conversion of uploaded files to Base64 strings.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Model class representing a catalog item with properties such as ID, type, brand, name, description, price, and image data. Includes static methods for image validation and base64 conversion.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates the image file based on its name and base64 data, checking size and extension.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Asynchronously converts an uploaded file into a Base64 string.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is among the allowed image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
